meta.name: internal-comms
meta.description: A set of resources to help me write all kinds of internal communications, using the formats that my company likes to use. Claude should use this skill whenever asked to write some sort of internal communications (status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按公司模板撰写各类内部通知与报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要频繁撰写公司内部沟通文档。
copy.tagline_en: Write internal communications using company-approved formats.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write internal company communications.

howto.what: 当你需要写内部沟通文档时，Claude 会按照你公司常用的格式来撰写，比如状态报告、领导层更新、项目更新等。
howto.when: 当你要求写内部沟通文档时触发，例如状态报告、领导层更新、3P 更新、公司通讯、FAQ、事故报告、项目更新等。

say.text: 帮我写一份本周的3P更新。
say.note: Claude 会加载 3P 更新模板并生成内容。

say.text: 写一份公司通讯，宣布新政策。
say.note: Claude 会使用公司通讯格式。

say.text: 回答员工关于远程办公的常见问题。
say.note: Claude 会按 FAQ 格式回答。

howto.what_en: When you need to write internal communications, Claude will use your company's preferred formats to draft documents like status reports, leadership updates, project updates, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to write internal communications such as status reports, leadership updates, 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, incident reports, project updates, etc.

say_en.text: Write a 3P update for this week.
say_en.note: Claude loads the 3P update template and generates content.

say_en.text: Write a company newsletter announcing a new policy.
say_en.note: Claude uses the company newsletter format.

say_en.text: Answer common questions about remote work.
